critique: The immense black trunk and vermilion canopy boldly frame a spacious blue lake, while the gold ginkgo, single umbrella figure, warm window, misted hills, and rippled reflections convincingly deliver Hasui-like solitude in a crisp, harmonized shin-hanga print. The broad translucent mist overlays risk reading as digitally airbrushed bands rather than printed bokashi; confining them behind the keyblock contours and giving their edges a subtler woodgrain breakup would better preserve the woodblock illusion.
